blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration swung back to a budget surplus in October, marking the third windfall of the year and snapping a five-month streak of deficits as revenues surpassed expenditures. According to the Bureau of the Treasury’s latest report, government surplus grew 23.14 percent to P13.7 billion. It was the first surplus since April […]...
